en.heading: September: Civil Service Month remembers public service since 1900
en.origin: Philippine Civil Service Month recognizes workers in public administration, their ethical responsibilities and their role in delivering services across an archipelago of communities. Its historical reference is the creation of the Philippine civil service under Public Law No. 5 in September 1900. That institutional event is older than the modern month-long commemoration. Proclamation No. 1050, signed 31 July 1997, declared September 1997 and every September thereafter Civil Service Month. It placed the programme under the Civil Service Commission, not a new paid holiday.
en.promoter: Civil Service Commission have the leading institutional role, where assigned in the original Philippine proclamation or legal record, for the observance's public activities.
en.purpose: Recognize public workers and strengthen professionalism, integrity and citizen-oriented services.

Proclamation No. 1050, signed 31 July 1997, declared September 1997 and every September thereafter Civil Service Month. It placed the programme under the Civil Service Commission, not a new paid holiday.

it.heading: Settembre: il Mese del servizio civile ricorda le origini del 1900
it.origin: Il Mese del servizio civile filippino riconosce il lavoro degli impiegati pubblici, la responsabilità etica e i servizi garantiti alle comunità dell'arcipelago. Il riferimento è l'istituzione del servizio civile filippino tramite la Legge pubblica n. 5 del settembre 1900, un evento precedente al moderno mese commemorativo. La Proclamazione n. 1050, firmata il 31 luglio 1997, istituì settembre 1997 e ogni settembre successivo, affidando le attività alla Civil Service Commission senza creare una festività non lavorativa.
it.promoter: Civil Service Commission sono gli enti guida indicati nei provvedimenti per coordinare la ricorrenza e le attività pubbliche nelle Filippine.
it.purpose: Valorizzare il lavoro pubblico e rafforzare professionalità, integrità e servizi rivolti ai cittadini.

es.origin: El Mes del Servicio Civil reconoce al personal de la administración pública, sus responsabilidades éticas y los servicios prestados en las comunidades. El antecedente histórico es la fundación del servicio civil mediante la Ley Pública n.º 5 de septiembre de 1900, anterior al mes conmemorativo moderno. La Proclamación n.º 1050, firmada el 31 de julio de 1997, estableció septiembre desde 1997 y encargó las actividades a la Comisión del Servicio Civil, sin crear un festivo no laborable.

en.heading: September: Rule of Law Month brings justice into schools
en.origin: Rule of Law Month in the Philippines encourages young people to learn how courts, rights and public institutions function and why lawful, fair processes matter. Proclamation No. 713 of 22 September 2004 declared every September Rule of Law Month and connected its educational purpose to the judiciary's programme of reform. The Department of Education was directed to coordinate school activities with the Supreme Court. The statutory month is an educational campaign, not an assertion that every September date is a national holiday.
en.promoter: Department of Education and Supreme Court of the Philippines have the leading institutional role, where assigned in the original Philippine proclamation or legal record, for the observance's public activities.
en.purpose: Promote education about the courts, constitutional rights and the responsibilities of public institutions.

La Proclamazione n. 713 del 22 settembre 2004 ha istituito ogni settembre come mese dedicato allo Stato di diritto, collegandolo al programma di riforma giudiziaria. Il Dipartimento dell'Istruzione deve coordinarsi con la Corte Suprema per le attività scolastiche. Il mese è una campagna educativa, non trasforma tutti i giorni di settembre in festività.

en.heading: December: National Volunteer Month and the bayanihan spirit
en.origin: National Volunteer Month celebrates Filipinos who give time, skills and resources to their neighbours, from local community projects to emergency and welfare initiatives. It draws on the bayanihan tradition of mutual aid. President Joseph Estrada signed Proclamation No. 55 on 5 December 1998, declaring December of every year National Volunteer Month under the Philippine National Volunteer Service Coordinating Agency. The recurring December proclamation is distinct from a separate May Volunteerism Month proclamation issued in 2009. These names are similar, but their periods and source texts must not be silently combined.
en.promoter: Philippine National Volunteer Service Coordinating Agency have the leading institutional role, where assigned in the original Philippine proclamation or legal record, for the observance's public activities.
en.purpose: Recognize volunteer work and strengthen civic participation and mutual aid in local communities.

en.heading: 10 October: Local Government Day marks the 1991 Local Government Code
en.origin: Local Government Day celebrates the role of provinces, cities, municipalities and barangays in Philippine governance and public services, with particular attention to the principle of local autonomy. Republic Act No. 7160, known as the Local Government Code of 1991, was signed on 10 October 1991. The date of this law provides the historical reason for the later yearly anniversary. Proclamation No. 63 of 2 October 1992 designated October Local Government Month, its second week Local Government Week and 10 October Local Government Day. These three durations are connected but not three interchangeable identical dates.
en.promoter: Department of the Interior and Local Government and Philippine local government units have the leading institutional role, where assigned in the original Philippine proclamation or legal record, for the observance's public activities.
en.purpose: Explain the origins of local autonomy and keep the day distinct from the wider October week and month.

La Proclamazione n. 63 del 2 ottobre 1992 ha definito ottobre come mese degli enti locali, la seconda settimana come settimana dedicata e il 10 ottobre come giornata specifica.

en.heading: December: a Month of Overseas Filipinos after the 1986 democratic transition
en.origin: The Month of Overseas Filipinos recognizes people who live, study or work outside the Philippines and their contributions through families, communities, remittances and participation in Philippine public life. President Corazon Aquino signed Proclamation No. 276 on 21 June 1988, assigning December 1988 and each following December to diaspora recognition. The proclamation recalls overseas participation in the country's democratic restoration. The 1988 proclamation expressly superseded Proclamation No. 91 of 1987. It is a month-long national acknowledgement, not a claim that every December date is a paid national holiday.
en.promoter: Philippine national government, agencies serving overseas Filipinos and diaspora organizations have the leading institutional role, where assigned in the original Philippine proclamation or legal record, for the observance's public activities.
en.purpose: Recognize the Filipino diaspora and its social, economic and democratic contributions.

La proclamazione del 1988 sostituì espressamente la n. 91 del 1987. Si tratta di un mese dedicato al riconoscimento e non di una festività retribuita per tutti i giorni di dicembre.

en.heading: January: Tropical Fabrics Month supports Philippine natural fibres
en.origin: Philippine Tropical Fabrics Month highlights locally grown or produced natural fibres and the textile industry's connection to agriculture, skilled work and cultural knowledge. The 2004 Tropical Fabrics Law (Republic Act No. 9242) provided a policy framework, while Proclamation No. 86 of 2010 called for a Philippine Tropical Fabrics Day on 24 January 2011. Proclamation No. 313, dated 12 January 2012, established the whole of January every year as Tropical Fabrics Month and tasked the Textile Research Institute with further research and engagement. It expanded an earlier single day.
en.promoter: Philippine Textile Research Institute of the Department of Science and Technology have the leading institutional role, where assigned in the original Philippine proclamation or legal record, for the observance's public activities.
en.purpose: Promote responsible development of local textile fibres, design and research.
